title: Check versions against dependency ranges
prompt:
The plugin registry needs to resolve dependency ranges. Please add an exported satisfies(version: string, range: string): boolean to src/semver.ts, using the range syntax in docs/RANGES.md: exact versions, =, <, <=, >, >=, ^, ~, hyphen ranges, x-ranges and partial versions, space-separated comparator sets that all must hold, and || alternatives. We only publish release versions, so there is no prerelease handling at all.

A few examples: satisfies("1.4.0", "^1.2.3") is true, satisfies("0.3.0", "^0.2.3") is false, satisfies("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3") is true and satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2") is true.

The version argument is validated like parseVersion does. Throw a TypeError when the version is invalid or the range doesn't fit the grammar in the doc (the doc has a list of invalid examples). Reuse parseVersion and compareVersions where it helps.
acceptance: Exact and = matches, comparison operators with full and partial versions, ANDed comparator sets with flexible whitespace, x-ranges/missing parts/empty range/wildcards with operators, tilde and caret tables including 0.x rules, hyphen ranges with partial and * bounds, || alternatives including an empty alternative, TypeError for invalid versions and for each invalid range listed in the doc.
difficulty_rationale: One function but many interacting rules (partial versions, caret zero handling, partial bounds per operator, hyphen ranges) described in a workspace doc.
